title: Adaptive Stopping of Streamed Reasoning for Language Model Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.27981v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reasoning-enabled language model agents can incur substantial computation before acting, although the reasoning needed varies across decisions. Existing stopping signals, such as confidence and intermediate-answer stability, can vary in effectiveness across reasoning models; signals obtained from hidden states or token probabilities also require internal access that may be unavailable or impractical. We introduce StreamStop, which learns model-specific stopping policies offline from prefix-level action agreement. A frozen prefix reader encodes available reasoning text for a lightweight stop head, allowing stopping without access to the reasoning model's internal signals. We construct and publicly release a dataset of agent reasoning trajectories with prefix-level action annotations. translated_title: 面向语言模型智能体的流式推理自适应停止
translated_abstract: 具备推理能力的语言模型智能体在行动之前可能产生大量计算开销，然而不同决策所需的推理量各不相同。现有的停止信号（如置信度和中间答案稳定性）在不同推理模型之间的有效性参差不齐；而基于隐藏状态或词元概率的信号则需要访问模型内部信息，这些访问可能不可用或不切实际。我们提出 StreamStop，它从前缀级别的动作一致性中离线学习针对特定模型的停止策略。一个冻结的前缀读取器对可获得的推理文本进行编码，供一个轻量级的停止头使用，从而无需访问推理模型的内部信号即可实现停止决策。我们构建并公开发布了一个包含智能体推理轨迹及前缀级别动作标注的数据集。这些标注将每个前缀动作与完整推理的参考动作进行对比，从而支持对停止规则的离线比较以及精确的期望回报评估。
tldr: 提出 StreamStop 方法，利用冻结的前缀读取器和轻量级停止头，从前缀级别动作一致性中离线学习针对特定模型的停止策略，无需访问推理模型内部信号即可自适应地停止语言模型智能体的流式推理，并发布了带前缀级别动作标注的推理轨迹数据集。
en_tdlr: StreamStop learns model-specific stopping policies offline from prefix-level action agreement using a frozen prefix reader and a lightweight stop head, enabling adaptive stopping of streamed reasoning for language model agents without internal model access, supported by a publicly released dataset of annotated reasoning trajectories.
